examples.arabic: بعدين، أحمد اشترى عيش طازة لأمه وإخواته.
examples.english: Then, Ahmed bought fresh bread for his mother and sisters.
examples.transliteration: Badeen, Ahmed eshtara eish taza le ommo w ekhwato.

examples.arabic: هو حط عشر شنط عيش جوه العربية بحرص.
examples.english: He put ten bags of bread inside the cart carefully.
examples.transliteration: Howa hat ashar shonat eish gowa el-arabiya be-hers.

examples.english: The smell of the local bread is very sweet
examples.transliteration: reehet el eish el baladi helwa awy

examples.english: The kids eat the bread and cheese quickly.
examples.transliteration: el welad beyaklo el eish wel gebna besorea

examples.english: The tomatoes are cheap but the bread is expensive.
examples.transliteration: el tomatem rkheesa bas el eish ghaly
